title: Conditional Heavy-q Dark Matter in Two-Phase SFV/dSB Cosmology: A Stable Ultraheavy Relic with a Derived Portal Production Channel
description: A dark-matter rederivation under the frozen SFV/dSB two-phase cosmology. The retained carrier is the pre-existing real scalar q: its ultraheavy mass, exact Z2 stability, cold/collisionless cosmology, and pair-production portal are derived without adding a new dark field or dark-sector coupling. The homogeneous abundance closes with one explicitly conditional universal post-handoff yield Y_q. The final provenance audit shows that the remaining first-principles obstruction is upstream in the 2+1 to 3+1 handoff/reheating state: absolute channel loading, the Phi-visible thermal connector, and the threshold-complete Pati-Salam thermal spectrum. Historical H8/Lambda_mem amplitudes are not used as inputs, and the paper does not claim first-principles absolute dark-matter abundance.
